decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly building up +1/+1 counters on creatures and artifacts, maximizing value from Hardened Scales and other counter synergies. Using Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista as key pieces, it aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and resilience. The inclusion of Urza's Saga adds additional versatility and tutoring power, while cards like The Ozolith and Animation Module help to further capitalize on the deck's main theme of counters. With a mix of creatures, artifacts, and lands all working towards the same goal, this deck is designed for fast-paced, explosive gameplay.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. It aims to maintain board presence with cards like Ice-Fang Coatl and Risen Reef while also ramping up with Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck also includes a toolbox of creatures like Solitude and Endurance to deal with various threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a longer game.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Boseiju, Who Endures. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Spell Pierce and Prismari Command while generating value with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. The deck aims to control the board and set up a game-winning combo with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding. The combination of creative card choices and powerful combo potential make this deck a unique and challenging archetype to pilot.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly build up mana through Cascade effects and efficiently cast powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury. With cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a continuous stream of threats while disrupting their game plan with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Endurance. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to enable consistent Cascade triggers, allowing the player to maintain pressure on the opponent and control the pace of the game.

The deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, using efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure on the opponent. It also includes a mix of disruption spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to control the game. The deck aims to quickly drop threats on the board while disrupting the opponent's game plan, allowing for a fast and powerful win condition. Additionally, the inclusion of card draw and filtering cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to maintain tempo and consistency in the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through aggressive creatures and direct burn spells. By efficiently using cards like Lightning Bolt, Boros Charm, and Rift Bolt, along with creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can set up their own game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of fetch lands and lands that can deal damage to you like Sunbaked Canyon allows for flexibility in mana fixing and card draw, while maintaining the deck's overall speed and aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively swarm the board with Elementals. This is achieved by using cards like Flamekin Harbinger to search for powerful Elementals, and Thunderkin Awakener to bring them back from the graveyard. Risen Reef and Ephemerate provide card advantage and additional triggers. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Solitude and Fury to control the board. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion enhances the deck's aggro strategy by giving all creatures of a chosen type a boost.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain control of the game with counterspells while applying pressure with efficient and evasive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while generating card advantage with Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. By utilizing a mix of tempo plays and card advantage, the deck seeks to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively cascade into powerful spells and creatures using cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, while controlling the board with cards like Force of Negation and Brazen Borrower. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing cards like Crashing Footfalls and Fury to apply pressure and end the game quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Dead / Gone and Endurance provides additional flexibility and disruption to handle various threats and strategies from opponents.

The deck focuses on building a board presence quickly with aggressive Human creatures, leveraging synergy and disruption to overwhelm the opponent. Key cards include Thalia, Guardian of Thraben for slowing down opponents, Adeline, Resplendent Cathar for generating tokens, and Champion of the Parish for growing in power. The deck also includes protection with cards like Solitude and Dauntless Bodyguard, while also providing card advantage and control with Esper Sentinel. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain board presence throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to combo off and cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. It also utilizes Leyline Binding to control the opponent's resources and protect its own combo pieces. The deck includes a mix of removal, countermagic, and card draw to help set up the combo while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The land base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and generate additional creature tokens with Dwarven Mine. Additionally, the deck features unique cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Persist to enhance its combo potential.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base and control the board with cards like Blood Moon, Prismatic Ending, and Lightning Bolt. It also utilizes creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure while maintaining card advantage. The inclusion of Obosh, the Preypiercer as a companion adds additional reach and power to the deck. Ultimately, the goal is to slow down the opponent's game plan, disrupt their resources, and close out the game efficiently with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on quickly milling the opponent's library using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Archive Trap while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Drown in the Loch and removal spells like Fatal Push. Tasha's Hideous Laughter can exile a large portion of the opponent's deck, paving the way for a quick victory through decking out. Jace, the Perfected Mind helps to close out the game by milling even more cards and providing card advantage. The deck aims to control the game through disruption and efficient mill cards to win the game before the opponent can execute their strategy.

The deck focuses on building up a board presence by cycling creatures with high mana costs in order to eventually cast Living End, which will return all those creatures to play for free. In the meantime, the deck uses disruption cards like Architects of Will and Force of Negation to control the game and protect its combo. The deck also incorporates alternate win conditions with cards like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves. Additionally, the deck has access to blue and red spells for added versatility and control options.

The main concept of this deck is to mill the opponent's deck (i.e. move cards from the opponent's library to the graveyard) while controlling the game with removal spells and counterspells. The deck uses cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity to mill the opponent, along with Archive Trap and Tasha's Hideous Laughter for additional mill power. The deck also includes cards like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch for removal, and Jace, the Mind Sculptor for additional control. The key strategy is to out-mill the opponent's deck before they can win through conventional means.

This deck focuses on efficiently using cascade spells to flood the board with threats and overwhelm the opponent. By playing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cast powerful spells for free and outpace the opponent. With a mix of versatile threats like Brazen Borrower and Bonecrusher Giant, as well as disruptive spells like Force of Negation, the deck looks to maintain pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Overall, the strategy revolves around explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent with a relentless aggro assault.
